crop.title: Crop a PDF
crop.description: Remove white margins manually or automatically.

crop.stepFileDescription: Page 1 is used as the preview for manual cropping.
crop.stepCropDescription: Choose a manual box or automatic margin detection.
crop.manualHelp: Draw the area to keep on the preview. You can also adjust its coordinates below.
crop.manualScope: The box drawn on page 1 is applied proportionally to every page.
crop.automaticHelp: The preview shows page 1; detection analyzes every page in the document.
crop.automaticScope: Visible content is detected page by page with a small safety margin. Blank pages are unchanged.
crop.previewFailed: This PDF could not be read in the preview.
crop.previewRequired: Wait for the PDF preview to be ready before cropping.
crop.selectionRequired: Draw or enter an area smaller than the full page.
